description: A Python module sourced from the gyp build system, containing functions for parsing, evaluating, and processing build configuration files (likely .gyp files). It includes mechanisms for handling variable expansion, condition evaluation, build file inclusion, dependencies, and parallel build file loading. The filename indicates it is part of the build input processing pipeline, specifically related to the 'input.py' component within the gyp system.
